summary: A Yes vote enacts a City of Highland transactions and use (sales) tax.

tax.text: The Yes campaign supports Measure E to fund police, fire, emergency services, and critical infrastructure through a new local sales tax.
tax.quote: Vote YES on Measure _ to maintain funding needed for City police, fire, and emergency services; and to maintain critical infrastructure.

tax.text: A No vote rejects Measure E’s proposed local sales tax for city services and infrastructure.
tax.quote: At its June 9, 2026 meeting, the City Council approved placing a local sales tax measure on the November 3, 2026 ballot for voter consideration.
